summary: The International Society for Disease Surveillance (ISDS) is a 501(c)3 nonprofit based in Boston, Massachusetts, dedicated to improving population health by advancing the science and practice of disease surveillance. It facilitates interdisciplinary collaboration and promotes and conducts research, education and advocacy. Its membership of 400+ includes subject matter experts in public health surveillance, clinical practice, health informatics, health policy and related national and global health fields. ISDS holds an annual national conference for the surveillance community.
one_line: ISDS is a Boston-based nonprofit with 400+ members that advances disease surveillance science, practice, and education.
